race.comment: DIAMOND SHOW (12) is in red-hot touch and was unlucky not to bring up the hat-trick last time, missing by a head to the hot-pot favourite. Carries a feather and should prove very hard to hold out. CHILLAXING (10) gets significant weight relief and drops back to a trip he relishes. Draws to blend in at the right time and is sure to be very competitive. DIVINE PURPOSE (11) is another lightweight chance. Should have enough speed to offset the tricky draw and race handy. FELIX THE SCAT (3) has been in good form this prep and will appreciate reuniting with Thompson, who piloted him to a strong win two back at Doomben. PRINCE LEVI (5) is going better than his form might read and will relish stepping back out to this trip. Gets his chance in front of the home crowd. CAVALRY MAN (4) is drawn sticky but is another handy gelding who deserves respect.
